# Setup

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
set.seed(23)
```

## Mean Error Analysis

Load matrices computed on AMD and Intel CPUs.

```{r}
algorithm = c("exact", "irlba", "rsvd")
file_amd = paste0("amd_", algorithm, ".csv")
file_intel = paste0("intel_", algorithm, ".csv")

df <- lapply(seq_along(algorithm), function(index) {

  amd <- read.csv(file = file_amd[index]) |> as.matrix()
  intel <- read.csv(file = file_intel[index]) |> as.matrix()
  diff <- amd - intel
  diff |> 
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(
      cell = 1:nrow(diff),
      algorithm = algorithm[index]
      )
  
  }) |>
  bind_rows()
```

Compare differences.

```{r}
df <- df |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("PC_")) |>
  mutate(pc = str_remove(name, "PC_")) |>
  mutate(pc = as.integer(pc))

# distribution
ggplot(df, aes(value, group = pc, color = pc)) +
  geom_freqpoly(bins = 100) +
  facet_wrap(~algorithm, ncol = 1)

# mean error
df |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(value), 
    .by = c(pc, algorithm)
    ) |>
  ggplot(aes(pc, mean, color = algorithm)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point()
```
